authorInfo.bio: Kathleen Mansfield Murry was a New Zealand writer and critic who was an important figure in the modernist movement. Her works are celebrated across the world and have been published in 25 languages. Writer and literary critic Irène Némirovsky considers her the “spiritual heir” to the tradition initiated by Anton Chekhov, especially in her short stories.
